name: Princess Kingdom
changes: Added a safe delete-selected-player action, with confirmation, protection against deleting the final remaining profile, and removal of that player’s Classic and Princess progress snapshots.
Added a persistent in-game active-player indicator so families can see whose profile is currently playing, including when multiple player profiles exist.
Preserved existing profile IDs, saved progress, team mode, and existing Princess artwork files; artwork is not duplicated in this update archive.
